description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the LeaveTypeAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations and validation rules for leave type API endpoints, using mock objects and fixtures to simulate interactions with data access objects and services. The class extends EndpointTestCase and covers methods such as getOne, create, update, delete, and getAll, along with validation rule tests.
